headline: W. Kamau Bell has the most practical ‘most indispensable tool’
summary: W. Kamau Bell is a prominent comedian, social commentator, and political activist. He is known for shows like 'United Shades of America' and 'We Need to Talk About Cosby'. Bell has earned a Peabody Award and four Emmys for his work.

headline: Amazon just hiked the prices for Echo, Fire TV, and Kindle products by up to 60 percent
summary: Amazon has significantly raised prices on Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, and Eero products by up to 60 percent. The company attributes these increases to 'significant increases in memory and storage component costs'. The Echo Dot smart speaker saw a substantial jump from $49.99 to $79.99.

headline: An okay laptop with 16GB of RAM is better than a nice laptop with 8GB, and this $520 HP OmniBook proves it
summary: Current laptop prices are distorted, making RAM a crucial performance factor. A laptop with 16GB of RAM often outperforms a 'nicer' one with only 8GB, regardless of other specs. The $520 HP OmniBook demonstrates the superior value of increased RAM in today's market.

headline: Two great new repairable gadgets
summary: The Installer newsletter highlights new advancements in repairable gadget technology. This edition focuses on getting back into the rhythm of exploring the latest tech. It mentions trying out ergonomic Switch accessories.

headline: IGN's Top Reviewed Movies of 2026 So Far
summary: IGN has already reviewed a significant number of movies slated for release in 2026. Only one film has received a perfect 10 out of 10 score from IGN reviewers. Interestingly, this top-rated movie has not even been officially released yet.

headline: Metal Gear Solid 4: The Flawed Masterpiece Kojima Didn't Want to Make
summary: Metal Gear Solid 4 is now available on modern consoles with the Master Collection Vol. 2. The article revisits the game's complex legacy, debating if it's a flawed masterpiece or merely a collection of lengthy cutscenes. It explores Hideo Kojima's well-documented reservations about developing the title.

headline: Ultra Graphics Settings Are a Scam: Why High Is Good Enough, if Not Better, for Most Players
summary: Playing games on 'Ultra' graphics settings is often unnecessary and provides minimal visual improvements. 'High' settings generally offer comparable visual quality while significantly boosting performance. The article argues smoother framerates are a worthwhile trade-off for imperceptible visual sacrifices.

headline: Sangster Directs Hammer Review
summary: Severin Films' review spotlights Jimmy Sangster's considerable impact on Hammer horror film history. The analysis emphasizes Sangster's pivotal contributions as both a writer and director for the studio. It also acknowledges actor Ralph Bates's role within the Hammer universe.

headline: Canadian PM calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has publicly called Trump's new tariffs a 'miscalculation'. Canada abandoned trade negotiations, asserting it did so to protect national sovereignty. The latest round of trade talks between the two nations has collapsed.

headline: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
summary: Rescuers are continuing to search for four missing individuals amidst the wreckage of a Ukrainian mall. Friday's Russian strike tragically killed 16 people and injured 130, including several children. President Zelensky has vehemently condemned the attack as 'despicable'.

headline: How this 1960s ex-council house is managing to stay cool without air con
summary: A 1960s ex-council house in the UK demonstrates effective cooling without the need for air conditioning. The property achieves its thermal efficiency by adhering to the rigorous Passivhaus standard. This approach is gaining popularity as UK homeowners adapt to increasingly hot summer temperatures.

headline: As they return to the UK, Harry and Meghan search for a brand that sticks
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are returning to the UK, but not in their former capacity as working royals. The couple is reportedly seeking to establish a new public identity or 'brand' for their future endeavors. The article speculates on potential new roles and projects for Harry and Meghan.
